title: Chapter 457
paragraphs: Chapter 457
131. People with Good Intuition, People with Bad Intuition (1)
At the end of January 1800, the city of Tichen was still bustling with activity as they moved and installed the equipment of the Black King's stronghold.

At first, the dispatched Guardian Knights from Runcandel were factors that severely damaged the pride and self-esteem of the Black King's members. But now, the members themselves found them to be quite convenient.
It was because they were holding their ground in the Kingdom of Bise that no flies could bother them.

If it weren't for Runcandel, Tichen's forces would have had to step in and take on that role. In the midst of the turbulent international situation caused by the sudden collapse of the Black King's stronghold, it was a rather exhausting role.
Above all, the members were satisfied with the change in leadership of the Guardian Knights stationed in the Kingdom of Bise.
"Hmm, those guys. I thought they'd be making bitter faces, but once I got here, they all seemed to calmly accept their defeat. No, they even seemed somewhat satisfied."
Crunch!
Mary bit into an apple as she spoke. The man standing next to her was, of course, Diphus Runcandel.

They had come to this place to prevent any unfortunate incidents involving other members or the Elders (although the atmosphere had been nearly crushed by Jin recently) mishandling the 'spoils of the youngest.'
As expected.
When they first arrived, Joshua's knights who were stationed there treated the Black King's members carelessly.

The Black King's members endured their unpleasant attitude so that their new master wouldn't get caught up in unnecessary conflicts. It was only after Mary and Diphus arrived that they could work happily.
The two of them had taken control of the Guardian Knights' morale. That behavior was not just born out of a desire to cherish the youngest.
Stimulation, anxiety that if someone clumsily touched the youngest, something might happen to the family again.
Even Mary, who could be described as 'crazy' for fighting, thought that Runcandel needed a brief period of stability.
"Well, on our first day here, everyone was on edge, except for Jin and the lower-ranked 2nd generation."
Diphus spoke as he caught the apple thrown by Mary.
For a while, the siblings sat on a tree, devouring dozens of apples while watching the Black King's members work.
"I should've fought the entire Black King's group once. I envy him, the youngest one."
Mary was more envious of the fact that Jin had fought against the Black King's group than the fact that he had gained control of them.
"Technically, it wasn't just the youngest who fought. If it weren't for Murakan, this outcome would never have been possible."

"I don't know. Murakan's strength was indeed great, as revealed this time, but the way the 2nd generation praises him in their articles is strangely persistent. It's like they're trying to completely exclude Jin's achievements and power from the Black King's incident."
"Is the excessive praise for Murakan to prevent Jin's power from being highlighted?"

"That's what I think. The 2nd generation, we, and everyone else in the family that day, saw it clearly with our own eyes, didn't we? The day he declared himself the family head, how incredible he was."
Recalling the image of Jin breaking the sword garden and the records of the Dark Sword and the King's Domain, chills and thrills ran down their spines.
"At that time, he showed such power right after his severed arms were healed. The possibility of him being in top condition was extremely low.
"But can you imagine it?"
"What?"
"The scene of him single-handedly destroying the Heukwangsan Fortress. Wielding that tremendous Demon Sword and Myeongwang Sword..."
As if imagining a delicious dish, Mary's mouth watered while thinking about that scene.
Diphus shook his head but couldn't deny his beloved sister's words. It was easy to imagine, not hard at all.
The thought of the person who single-handedly destroyed the Sword Garden having trouble with Heukwangsan Fortress seemed strange.

"If Murakan had fought on his behalf, would the Heukwangdan be working so contentedly? Their eyes seem to deeply acknowledge their new lord. Entrusting the Guardian Dragon to a whiny kid? That's impossible."
"Listening to you, it does make sense."
"Moreover, after observing for a few days, the equipment in Heukwangsan Fortress - the important ones are surprisingly intact. I don't think it's just luck."
"...Are you saying he fought while controlling his power so that important spoils wouldn't be damaged?"
"Yes."
Honestly, it was an unbelievable story.
But in reality... strangely enough, none of the most expensive and hard-to-find equipment was damaged beyond repair.
The siblings couldn't know.
It was purely a matter of luck.

On the day Zephyrin went on a rampage, her attack fortunately missed all of Heukwangdan's most valuable equipment. Even the landslide that occurred without a moment's rest couldn't destroy those pieces of equipment.
It was just due to luck!
Excluding that inexplicable level of luck, Mary's imagination soared far away. Even Diphus felt doubtful, unsure whether it could be true or not.
Once again, silence flowed between the siblings as the Heukwangdan members started singing a cheerful work song that echoed through the mountains.
"Anyway."
With a crunch, Mary crushed the last remaining apple core with her teeth and continued.
"We need to become stronger. Brother. My intuition tells me so."
"What?"
"To fight that young guy."
Whether they fought against or alongside him.
Diphus felt as if there was always a hidden meaning behind Mary's voice.
"You always thirst for strength without reason, and now it's suddenly new?"
"A loving sister and a nemesis among nemeses, each other's mountain to overcome! Ah, isn't this kind of thing exciting?"
Feeling a strange bitterness, Diphus let out a small laugh.
"Go back and find out what kind of medicine you need for your headache, and I understand what you want."
At that, Mary's eyes sparkled, and Diphus continued.
"Do whatever you want for a while. Cause accidents as you please, and train as you please. I'll take responsibility and handle the consequences."
"Of course, no one understands my heart better than our second eldest brother!"
"Is it only at times like this that I'm your brother? When will you become human?"

"Don't try to talk nonsense later. The fourth generation of the great Runcandel wouldn't speak double, would it? I'll go now, and you take care of everything here. You'll also handle my duties for a while."
"Hey, hey, Mary! Hey!"
Before Diphus could catch her, Mary was already running madly towards the foot of the mountain. Her sprint was so fast that trees broke and dust clouds rose.
"Sigh... I hope she doesn't cause an unbearable accident like before. I should have chosen my words more carefully."
Suddenly, a strong anxiety crept up on Diphus's spine.
Dox McRolan still hadn't fully recovered.
However, upon regaining Clo and being able to move at about 30% of his usual capacity, Dox immediately left the City of Tikan, leaving only a note behind.

(I won't forget that you got me Numerus's blood and even that godforsaken thing to save me. I admit, without your efforts, I would have died in vain and wouldn't have been able to dedicate my remaining life to the family.
Nevertheless, as a Black Knight, I cannot follow your command.
Instead, I will carry out your command as Dox McRolan. I will send a letter as soon as it's done, so I hope you understand that I didn't break my promise and run away.)
Surprisingly.
Dox left Tikan 'undetected by anyone.'
In other words, the opposite was also possible.
The reason Joshua's Black Knights hadn't infiltrated Tikan all this time wasn't due to a lack of ability, but because of Chiron's command.
'He's not someone who doesn't know gratitude. I didn't expect him to give a gift and go.'
Jin knew that Dox secretly left, subtly informing him of this fact.
"Sir Valkas."
"Speak, my lord."
"How much can the security level of Tikan be improved once all the equipment is moved?"
"It depends on how much you invest in security, my lord."
"Whether it's manpower or money, please provide everything we need to the fullest extent."

"That's what I had in mind too. You've seen the message left by the Black Knight precisely. If a less recovered Black Knight could escape like this, there's no need to mention a Black Knight in perfect condition."

Although Valkas had accepted Jin as his lord, on the other hand, he also played the role of testing Jin whenever an opportunity arose. As a leader who had successfully led a large force longer and earlier than Jin, Jin liked Valkas's role selection.
"Then, my lord, what's next?"
When suddenly there's an influx of new people, the best course of action a leader can take is to consolidate power and organize ranks.
Valkas hoped that Jin would not give such a textbook answer.
"We need to consolidate power and organize ranks at this point."
"Tsk."

"But that's not my job. Consolidation, or rather, creating a proper atmosphere will be done by the existing Tikan members excluding myself as much as possible, but organizing ranks is each person's responsibility. I won't interfere at all."
"You won't interfere at all?"

"As we suddenly became a family, fights are inevitable, right? If I step in, I can't help but take someone's side, so I should leave it to the winners and losers to sort out their ranks. However, killing each other or crippling each other is forbidden. I'll personally cut the throat of anyone who does that."
Valkas couldn't help but applaud inwardly.

'Lata Proch, it's no wonder that the young mad dog has become a puppy. The kid who was called the young emperor by the three armies more than a decade ago has now become a giant leading Valkas and the Black King Knights.'
Suddenly, he remembered what Lata and Jet said at the drinking party last night.
-Valkas might be lucky, after all. I lost the subordinate my lord cherished the most, my only younger sibling was captured, and only after I was beaten in a fight did I discover his value.

-As for me, thanks to my lord... Haha, I literally had a hard time. How convincing it was when I played the role of Veradin Zipple. When I first came to Tikan, I was a complete beggar. I was living as a well-off parasite in the Akin Kingdom, but after getting involved with my lord, I finally became a valuable person.

-On the other hand, didn't the Black King Knights only lose their base and reputation? Even so, the base still had most of the important equipment left, and as for the reputation... I'm sure of it. When our lord ascends to the throne of the world, the Black King Knights will gain a reputation tens of times more brilliant than what they had before. The same goes for me and this friend Jet.
Valkas smiled.
"That was an excellent answer, my lord. Then, what should you do?"
Then, Jin answered without hesitation.
"Mercenary Amela."
That was the correct answer.
"We need to capture her. If capture is impossible, we must keep her in check effectively."
